title: Fixed Clamp and Fork-Shaft Fruit Peeler
description: One newly authored whole table-clamped hand-crank fruit-peeling device in a static empty pose. One open C-clamp casting grows into a tall short shaft-bearing boss, a horizontal fruit-carrier shaft ends in three long tapered prongs, and its opposite end carries a real offset crank and thick grip. An independent curved side arm reaches an open-loop blade carrier beside the fruit axis. A lower pressure screw and broad pad complete the clamp opening. This is not the old tall-post can opener with two cutting wheels, nor a vertical lever citrus press. Empty static art prop, one model and zero scenes; no actual cutting, peeling, coring, food-contact, adjustment or safe clamping performance is claimed.
